data.title: ME Therapeutics Extends Option Agreement for CD22 Nanobody Asset
data.description: ME Therapeutics Holdings Inc., a biotechnology company based in Vancouver, British Columbia, has extended its option agreement to license the National Research Council of Canada’s proprietary nanobody-based CD22 binder for utilization in Chimeric Antigen Receptor therapy. The company, listed on the CSE as METX and on the FSE as Q9T, focuses on innovative cancer treatments in the immuno-oncology sector. This extension marks a significant advancement in ME Therapeutics' commitment to developing cutting-edge drugs for cancer treatment.

data.title: Service Properties Trust Confirms Receipt of Unsolicited Proposal for Hotel Portfolio From TKO Hotels
data.description: Service Properties Trust, based in Newton, Massachusetts, confirmed receiving an unsolicited $2.0 billion cash offer from TKO LLC to acquire its hospitality portfolio. This offer came without prior contact from TKO. The Company's Board of Trustees will thoroughly assess TKO's proposal to decide on the next steps in the best interest of the company.

data.title: Could Menopause Hold Clues to Women's Alzheimer's Risk?
data.description: A research project funded by a $3.4 million grant from the National Institutes of Health at Rosalind Franklin University aims to investigate the impact of hormonal shifts during perimenopause on memory-related brain circuits. Located in North Chicago, Illinois, the study seeks to address the prevalence of Alzheimer's disease, with women representing about 66% of the total number of Americans affected by the condition. The project, initiated on October 9, 2026, aims to deepen understanding of how hormonal changes in midlife influence cognitive function, particularly in relation to memory processes.

data.title: Network of Giving Lifts Off in Seattle and Edmonton
data.description: Seattle and Edmonton are the pioneering cities for the launch of Network of Giving, a unique program that enhances community support. This initiative integrates a connected loyalty platform into businesses of varying sizes, facilitating charitable donations, and quantifiable community benefits all through a singular network. Local merchants have the discretion to decide the extent of their contributions towards regional nonprofits, marking a significant step forward in community collaboration and philanthropy.

data.title: Hurricane Isaias Warning: Protect Your Family from CO Poisoning and Other Post-Storm Dangers
data.description: On October 9, 2026, the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) issued a statement advising individuals in the trajectory of Hurricane Isaias to safeguard against carbon monoxide (CO) poisoning, fires, and other potential dangers post-storm. The Commission emphasized the importance of taking preventive measures to ensure the safety of themselves and their families during the hurricane.

data.title: Truist Foundation announces $250,000 grant ahead of Hurricane Isaias landfall
data.description: The Truist Foundation in Charlotte, N.C. revealed on October 9, 2026, its plan to offer financial assistance to aid both immediate relief efforts and long-term recovery in Gulf Coast communities. This initiative was prompted by the imminent arrival of Hurricane Isaias, which poses a significant threat to these areas. The foundation's commitment aims to support communities in need and ensure their recovery by providing essential resources during this challenging period.
